Join Up: natural horsemanship lesson, no riding

1 hr - 1.5 hr · per person, up to 2 · Bali · Run by Salty Cowboy

Overview

An introduction to natural horsemanship. Learn to "join up" a horse so it chooses to stay with you. Hands-on, grounded, and entirely off the saddle.
